Are you ready to take on a pivotal role in an innovative company? As a Welding Coordinator in Alkmaar, you will work 40 hours a week, ensuring the highest welding quality in the production of stainless steel hoses, flow systems, and skids, all in compliance with ISO 3834-2 standards. This role is both challenging and varied, as you collaborate with different teams and serve as the go-to person for welding technical inquiries. 
Your day begins with a team meeting, followed by checking ongoing welding projects. You will set up procedures, perform quality controls, and provide advice to colleagues. Additionally, you will train employees and work closely with suppliers and external inspectors. No two days are the same! 
 Wij bieden - 
 - Salary between €4500 and €5100 per month; - Full-time position, 40 hours per week; - 25 vacation days plus 12 ATV days; - Profit-sharing scheme up to 18% of your annual salary; - Opportunities for training and growth; - Excellent fringe benefits; - Work in an engaged and close-knit team; - Innovative working environment with room for your own input.

 - MBO diploma in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering or Welding Technology; - At least 2 years of experience as a welding coordinator or in a similar role; - Knowledge of welding processes and quality standards, including ISO 3834-2 and ISO 5817; - Certificate IWS, IWT, or IWE is a plus; - Proficiency in English, both spoken and written; - Precise and communicative work style; - Residence within 30 km of Alkmaar.
